subject: Banking
title: Credit Freezes and Fraud Alerts
description: A 60-second lesson on Credit Freezes and Fraud Alerts.

hook.text: A credit freeze blocks anyone from opening accounts in your name. After the Equifax breach, freezes became free by law.

buildup.text: Without a freeze, a thief with your Social Security number can open credit cards, loans, and utilities in your name.

discovery.text: You must freeze your credit at all three bureaus separately. Freezing one leaves two others open for fraud.

twist.text: A fraud alert only lasts one year and just asks lenders to verify identity. A freeze actually blocks access entirely.

climax.text: Credit freezes are the most effective identity theft prevention. They're free, reversible, and work immediately.

punchline.text: Free, instant, and the best identity theft protection. Freeze all three bureaus.

quiz.question: What does a credit freeze do?
options: Blocks anyone from opening new accounts in your name
